acceptance_basis: Strict finite complete-message/tool request validation rejects unsupported or uncounted payload fields.
Verified private local snapshots bind model/config, tokenizer, special tokens, template and pinned runtime identities to content hashes.
The independent literal framing and separate real tokenizer oracle matches full compiled IDs, including Unicode, HTML-like text, tool definitions and tool history.
A real tiny CPU model receives the exact admitted token IDs in generate and forward; execute does not render or tokenize again.
Input length plus positive reserved output is checked before inference; exact fit is admitted and overflow refused without truncation.
Authenticated immutable artifacts reject field forgery, cross-consumer use, runtime identity drift and post-tokenization mutation before dispatch.
Generated output must retain the admitted prefix and remain inside the reservation; dispatch failures are sanitized and never automatically retried.
Python and HTTP memory recall integrate into the complete final model request without broadening the memory profile or legacy generation surface.
Candidate inventory, release ledger and documentation consistently close only milestone 3 while preserving remaining qualification gates.

independent_focused_validation.warning: Starlette TestClient uses the deprecated AnyIO BlockingPortal alias.

limits_and_non_claims: Reviewed-source acceptance does not assert publication, exact-source remote CI or production readiness.
The real model fixture demonstrates tokenization, budgeting and dispatch correctness, not language quality or live-agent outcomes.
No qualification of other models, templates, architectures, operating systems, Python versions, hardware, remote endpoints, GPU or native-KV paths.
Pinned direct dependencies do not qualify every transitive dependency combination; full live-model hashing is not a large-model latency or capacity claim.
The boundary assumes cooperating callers; hostile private-state mutation or a writer replacing a complete bundle and all declared hashes is outside its integrity model.
Artifacts are ephemeral consumer-owned capabilities, not durable receipts, cross-process caches or exactly-once execution guarantees.
No tool execution or logical tool-call pairing validation, durable decision replay, filesystem/crash qualification or quality/release promotion is established.
